title: fused (DJ-Kicks)
direction: Flagship sync candidate. Hold the first ~2 seconds relatively restrained, then let the major transition around 2:06–2:08 cause the rainfall to acquire obvious structure. Use 2–4 drop clusters, selected stronger impacts, and breathing room. Never map every drum hit.
